purpose: Which design choices of SA-LHFiD matter, on the simulated real problem (same truths, noise and budget as configs/nas/sa_simulation.json). Each arm changes one setting of the C2 configuration. Fixed before any ablation run.

indicators.primary: true 4-D hypervolume of all evaluated points (noise-free truth, scaled space, reference 1), as in sa_simulation
indicators.secondary: deliverable: greedy hypervolume subset selection of 5 points on the observed (noisy) values, scored by their true hypervolume; and the in-box count

statistics: per truth: Wilcoxon signed-rank (paired by seed; the noise stream is shared) of each arm against base, Holm over the 11 comparisons; an effect is claimed only if significant in the same direction under both truths
